title: Part Seventeen: Rome and Zionism II: Non-Recognition to Recognition, 1945–1993

sections.brief: Partition and the corpus separatum (res. 181, 33-13-10; Latin American votes; the Sneh-Tardini meeting of 3 Oct 1947 as a disputed recollection); Auspicia quaedam, In multiplicibus curis (24 Oct 1948), Redemptoris nostri cruciatus (15 Apr 1949); res. 303 (38-14-7); the Pontifical Mission for Palestine (1949); the Irish files on a Catholic mandate (Vatican reluctant 'to disclose its hand'); the Pius XII files on Palestine (Rioli 2024, not checked); contact without recognition. Figures: fig-time

Two tracks, theology of the Jewish people vs diplomacy toward the state: Paul VI's 1964 visit without naming Israel; Nostra Aetate 4 (28 Oct 1965, 2,221-88; deicide charge rejected; Wardi affair delay); 1967 special statute; Meir 1973; the Commission (22 Oct 1974) and Guidelines; Arafat 1982; Redemptionis anno (1984); the 1985 Notes (international law); synagogue 1986; Waldheim 1987. Figures: fig-compare (two tracks)

Stated reasons for non-recognition (Rosen, Israel MFA, AP); Madrid (30 Oct 1991), the April 1992 decision and the July 1992 commission; Oslo (13 Sep 1993); the Fundamental Agreement of 30 Dec 1993 article by article, Art. 11 quoted in full; reception; entry into force, 1994 protocol, 1997 Legal Personality Agreement; the timing test. Figures: fig-compare (timing test)
